# Select

Selects one or several (`mode="multiple"`) values from a list of options; add `showSearch` when there are many
options.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Filters, enumerated form fields, choosing members and roles

## Import

```ts
import { Select } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Single selection; add `showSearch` when there are many options.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return <Select placeholder="Select a category" options={kinds} allowClear />
}
```

## Variants

### Multiple selection and search

```tsx
export function Multiple() {
  return (
    <Select
      mode="multiple"
      showSearch
      optionFilterProp="label"
      defaultValue={['design']}
      options={kinds}
      block
    />
  )
}
```

### Full width

Add `block` outside forms when the select must be as wide as other inputs.

```tsx
export function Block() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Select block placeholder="Select a category" options={kinds} />
      <Select
        block
        placeholder="Select a status"
        options={[{ value: 'active', label: 'Active' }]}
      />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## States

### Loading and disabled

```tsx
export function States() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Select block loading placeholder="Loading…" />
      <Select block disabled defaultValue="design" options={kinds} />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | `boolean` | Fills the width of the container. Use it for selects in form fields, and outside forms when the select must be as wide as other inputs. | — | No |

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`SelectProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
